elements.name: DevRelay
elements.description: Deterministic orchestration runtime for composable software-engineering modules.
responsibilities: Progress exact approved artifacts through provider-neutral modules, gates, and trusted traceability.

elements.name: Generic Core
elements.description: Owns generic registration, state-derived routing, exact adapter resolution, checkpoints, replay, and progression.
responsibilities: Load exact state and artifact contracts.
Route without product-specific branches.
Checkpoint and replay bounded effects and control results.

elements.name: TraceabilityGraph
elements.description: Core-owned sidecar for trusted lifecycle traceability contributions and atomic merge proofs.
responsibilities: Replay approved upstream observer contributions.
Keep candidate and approved authority distinct.
Validate and atomically merge registered contributor updates.

elements.name: WorkBreakdown Module
elements.description: Converts exact approved scope into bounded, traceable, independently executable and verifiable work-item candidates.
responsibilities: Own establish-breakdown and decompose-change semantic contracts.
Normalize configured planning adapter output.
Return candidates without executing work.

elements.name: Context-neutral Upstream Validators
elements.description: Composes schema and semantic validators for requirements, project overview, architecture, contract, repository, and capability inputs without reusing ArchitectureDesign operation-specific runtime contracts.
responsibilities: Validate exact upstream artifacts in a WorkBreakdown-neutral context.
Enforce approved absence unions and cross-artifact lineage.

elements.name: Configured Planning Adapter Port
elements.description: Provider-neutral port for one bounded work-decomposition capability selected by configuration.
responsibilities: Invoke Spec Kit tasks, OpenSpec tasks, or a compatible planner through the same canonical contract.
Allow read and planning-artifact output only.

elements.name: Registered WorkBreakdown Preflight
elements.description: Generic guard registered on the loaded ProjectWorkBreakdownState artifact contract with its own persisted producer identity.
responsibilities: Detect exact baseline, disposition, revision, and tree drift before adapter entry.
Schema-validate baseline_drift results.
Checkpoint and replay the control result without adapter entry.

elements.name: WorkBreakdown Gate
elements.description: Derives the authoritative coverage universe, resolves evidence, owns no-work approval, and promotes approved planned work.
responsibilities: Reject unscoped or uncovered work.
Approve or reject already-satisfied and no-work-required dispositions.
Atomically promote a baseline or apply an exact typed delta.

elements.name: WorkBreakdown Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Trusted projector of validated candidate work items into limited planning relationships.
responsibilities: Create only approved planning edge kinds.
Preserve candidate authority until gate activation.
Never create inverse or factual completion edges.

elements.name: Approved Baseline Observers
elements.description: Replays approved RequirementsBaseline, ArchitectureBaseline, and applicable ContractBaseline graph contributions before WorkBreakdown candidate edges.
responsibilities: Materialize approved upstream endpoints and authority.
Forbid contract endpoints and contract refs when ApprovedNotApplicable is selected.

elements.name: Downstream Work Modules
elements.description: WorkDependencyAnalysis, SpecialistAssignment, WorkExecution, and Verification own ordering, assignment, execution, and proof.
responsibilities: Validate the dependency DAG.
Assign specialists.
Perform work and collect completion evidence.

elements.name: WorkDependencyAnalysis
elements.description: Coordinates one complete static dependency-analysis candidate without assigning or executing work.
responsibilities: Normalize dependency proposals
Coordinate bounded reviewer and Core-owned verification capabilities

elements.name: Snapshot Builder
elements.description: Builds one immutable full WorkBreakdown snapshot and verifies declared context slices.
responsibilities: Bind the exact WorkBreakdownBaseline
Verify source and extracted-content digests

elements.name: Graph Mechanics
elements.description: Owns canonical DAG mechanics while using pinned Graphology and Graphology-DAG internally.
responsibilities: Reject invalid endpoints, duplicates, self-dependencies, and cycles
Emit canonical diagnostics

elements.name: OPA Policy Evaluator
elements.description: Evaluates a pinned policy bundle over one canonical JSON input and normalizes the decision set.
responsibilities: Bind bundle, entrypoint, input, engine, and raw result evidence
Return policy decisions without promotion authority

elements.name: WorkDependency Gate
elements.description: Owns semantic completeness review, exact approval, and dependency-baseline promotion.
responsibilities: Reject unresolved missing dependencies and impossible ordering
Promote only the exact candidate

elements.name: Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Derives forward candidate dependency relationships after candidate validation.
responsibilities: Emit only approved relationship vocabulary
Checkpoint updates before atomic graph merge

elements.name: Dependency Proposal Port
elements.description: Admits the native structured proposer or an optional configured proposal adapter through one contract.
responsibilities: Expose only DependencyProposal semantics
Prevent adapter authority leakage

elements.name: Native Structured Proposer
elements.description: Default provider-neutral proposer over the complete snapshot and declared context slices.
responsibilities: Propose dependency edges
Disposition every dependency hint

elements.name: Optional Adapter Bridge
elements.description: Task Master and OpenSpec bindings that may propose only the canonical DependencyProposal.
responsibilities: Normalize native proposal output
Preserve subordinate native evidence

elements.name: Spec Kit Consistency Reviewer
elements.description: Advisory consistency and coverage reviewer over the normalized proposal.
responsibilities: Report bounded findings
Never create authoritative edges or approve progression

elements.name: Lifecycle Reporting
elements.description: Cross-cutting operational history and human-readable projection without workflow authority.
responsibilities: Persist exact standardized run records and observations
Project traceable lifecycle snapshots and human-readable reports
Expose sourced performance and adapter-maturity evidence

elements.name: Workflow Fact Recorder
elements.description: Derives standardized immutable run records from trusted Core transitions and Gate results.
responsibilities: Record exact module, Gate, adapter, checkpoint, approval, and progression facts
Bind every record to execution and artifact identities

elements.name: Integrated Completion Registry
elements.description: Stores separately approved verified integration facts without mutating the static dependency DAG.
responsibilities: Admit only exact verified ChangeIntegration completion facts
Preserve work-item, ChangeSet, verification, and integration lineage

elements.name: Ready Frontier Resolver
elements.description: Derives the current runnable work frontier from the immutable WorkDependencyBaseline and integrated completion facts.
responsibilities: Reject readiness inferred from assignment, execution start, or unintegrated changes
Return deterministic ready, blocked, completed, and failed dependency dispositions

elements.name: Run Ledger Store
elements.description: Append-only content-addressed store for trusted workflow records and explicitly non-authoritative observations.
responsibilities: Preserve exact raw records and lineage
Reject record substitution, duplicates with divergent bytes, and invalid authority claims

elements.name: Host Observation Ingress
elements.description: Admits sourced timing, wait, call, token, cost, retry, and replay observations without workflow authority.
responsibilities: Require captured, not-reported, or not-applicable disposition
Bind measurements to exact run and execution identities

elements.name: Adapter Maturity Resolver
elements.description: Resolves evidence-backed adapter binding maturity separately from Core-owned implementations.
responsibilities: Admit only contract-defined, fixture-conformant, live-conformant, or release-ready
Link every maturity claim to exact binding and evidence

elements.name: Run Comparability Evaluator
elements.description: Allows relative performance claims only for explicitly comparable executions.
responsibilities: Compare module, operation, input, policy, circuit, and host dimensions
Return non-comparable with exact reasons on any mismatch

elements.name: Lifecycle Snapshot Projector
elements.description: Purely projects the run ledger, graph checkpoint, maturity evidence, and policy results into one canonical snapshot.
responsibilities: Discover circuit components from records rather than product identifiers
Join business-to-acceptance paths and coverage diagnostics

elements.name: Report Content Policy
elements.description: Applies deterministic allow, omit, and redact dispositions before human-readable projection.
responsibilities: Exclude credentials, secrets, and unrestricted raw prompts or tool logs
Preserve audit links and explicit omission dispositions

elements.name: Lifecycle Markdown Renderer
elements.description: Renders byte-deterministic LifecycleRunReport.md from one validated canonical snapshot.
responsibilities: Lead with an executive summary and readable stage table
Render outcomes, Gates, rework, metrics, important artifacts, and next actions

elements.name: Report Access Port
elements.description: Exposes the exact structured snapshot, Markdown report, and linked evidence to IDE and host consumers.
responsibilities: Serve only validated content-addressed report artifacts
Expose no mutation, routing, approval, or evidence-satisfaction operation

elements.name: ContractGeneration
elements.description: Generates typed machine-readable contract candidates through configured replaceable adapters without owning approval.
responsibilities: Expose establish-contracts and generate-contract-change operations
Invoke exactly configured contract-kind generators
Return one typed ContractDraftSet or ContractChangeSetDraft

elements.name: Contract Generator Port
elements.description: Provider-neutral adapter boundary for generating typed contract candidates from exact interface intent.
responsibilities: Pass only declared contract kind, exact inputs, configuration, and grants
Receive canonical draft entries plus subordinate native artifacts

elements.name: JSON Schema Generator Binding
elements.description: V1 live-conformant binding for JSON Schema draft 2020-12 generation.
responsibilities: Generate one schema candidate per declared JSON Schema interface intent
Preserve native generator provenance and canonical entry mapping

elements.name: Optional Contract Adapter Bridge
elements.description: Shared bounded port for OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf, and future contract generators.
responsibilities: Use the same ContractGeneration operation and typed result contract
Keep optional binding maturity explicit and evidence-backed

elements.name: Contract State Route Guard
elements.description: Selects the ContractGeneration operation from exact approved contract state and architecture intent.
responsibilities: Select establish-contracts when no ContractBaseline exists
Select generate-contract-change when an exact ContractBaseline exists
Route zero-required-intent cases to ContractGate ApprovedNotApplicable preparation

elements.name: Pinned Contract Validator Registry
elements.description: Runs version-pinned kind-specific format validators independently of generators.
responsibilities: Validate schema dialect, syntax, references, and canonical bytes
Return exact validator identity, version, input digest, and findings

elements.name: Canonical Contract Differ
elements.description: Computes additions, modifications, removals, prior and target digests, and compatibility facts.
responsibilities: Compare exact normalized contract baseline and candidate sets
Canonicalize change ordering and compatibility evidence inputs

elements.name: Contract Gate
elements.description: Owns semantic completeness, compatibility policy, approval, and exact baseline or not-applicable promotion.
responsibilities: Require every contract-required InterfaceIntent to be covered exactly once
Apply compatibility policy independently of generator claims
Promote only exact checkpoint-replayed bytes after approval

elements.name: Contract Candidate Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Projects validated candidate contract relationships without making them authoritative.
responsibilities: Derive only declared candidate graph vocabulary from validated typed entries
Preserve candidate scope and execution lineage

elements.name: Approved Contract Baseline Observer
elements.description: Projects active contract facts only from an exact ContractGate promotion proof.
responsibilities: Activate InterfaceIntent to Contract relationships after approval
Retire or supersede prior contract facts without deleting history

elements.name: SpecialistAssignment
elements.description: Produces one complete typed assignment candidate by combining Core-approved eligibility sets with configured replaceable ranking, without owning approval.
responsibilities: Expose one assign-specialists operation over the complete approved work plan
Invoke the configured ranker only after Core computes exact eligible profiles
Return one complete SpecialistAssignmentDraft covering every approved work item or needs-clarification

elements.name: Specialist Ranker Port
elements.description: Provider-neutral ranker boundary that accepts only Core-computed eligible profile sets for exact work items.
responsibilities: Pass exact work-item identities, eligible profile sets, tie policy, configuration, and grants
Receive ranked profile selections, rationale, and subordinate native evidence without eligibility authority

elements.name: Native Structured Ranker
elements.description: V1 deterministic default ranker over Core-supplied eligible profile sets.
responsibilities: Select exactly one profile per work item using stable ordering and explicit tie policy
Preserve ranker provenance, rationale, eligible-set digest, and selected-profile mapping

elements.name: Optional Ranker Adapter Bridge
elements.description: Shared bounded port for optional policy-aware or future ranking implementations.
responsibilities: Use the same eligible-set input and ranked-selection output contract
Keep optional binding maturity explicit and evidence-backed

elements.name: Assignment Input Guard
elements.description: Validates exact approved work, dependency, catalog, policy, project, and repository inputs before extension entry.
responsibilities: Select assign-specialists from exact approved work and catalog state
Recompute a complete candidate when an exact current SpecialistAssignmentBaseline exists
Reject an empty or uncovered approved work plan unless an explicit upstream no-work disposition exists

elements.name: Core Eligibility Evaluator
elements.description: Computes the exact eligible specialist profiles for each work item from capabilities, tools, grants, and assignment policy before ranking.
responsibilities: Validate catalog identities and enforce every hard capability, tool, grant, and policy constraint
Return ordered eligible profile sets, exclusion reasons, policy identity, and exact input digest

elements.name: Candidate Assembler
elements.description: Validates ranker selections against the eligible sets and assembles one complete canonical assignment candidate.
responsibilities: Require exactly one eligible selection for every approved work item and no unscoped assignment
Canonicalize assignments, rationale, coverage, and prior-baseline comparison evidence

elements.name: Specialist Assignment Gate
elements.description: Owns semantic completeness, assignment-policy policy, approval, and exact baseline promotion.
responsibilities: Require every approved WorkItem to be assigned exactly once to an eligible profile
Reject partial candidates and independently verify policy, rationale, tools, grants, and evidence
Promote only exact checkpoint-replayed bytes after approval

elements.name: Assignment Candidate Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Projects validated candidate assignment relationships without making them authoritative.
responsibilities: Derive only declared candidate graph vocabulary from validated typed entries
Preserve candidate scope and execution lineage

elements.name: Approved Assignment Baseline Observer
elements.description: Projects active assignment facts only from an exact SpecialistAssignmentGate promotion proof.
responsibilities: Activate WorkItem to SpecialistProfile assignment relationships after approval
Retire or supersede prior assignment facts without deleting history

elements.name: WorkExecution
elements.description: Executes one Core-selected runnable work item per immutable attempt through a provider-neutral executor port.
responsibilities: Accept one exact readiness-approved WorkItem
Invoke one configured executor binding
Return proposed changes and raw evidence without verification or integration claims

elements.name: Executor Port
elements.description: Provider-neutral boundary for one exact execution attempt.
responsibilities: Pass immutable work, context, workspace, policy, and binding inputs
Receive exact change-set draft, raw evidence, diagnostics, and native artifacts

elements.name: Codex Task Executor Adapter
elements.description: First dogfood binding that maps one attempt to one user-visible Codex task and preserves its structured handoff.
responsibilities: Create one task for one assigned work item
Return exact task identity, handoff bytes, proposed changes, and evidence

elements.name: A2A Executor Adapter
elements.description: Optional binding that performs the same attempt contract through a version-pinned A2A agent endpoint.
responsibilities: Bind an approved profile and Agent Card to one task request
Preserve A2A request, task, artifact, and terminal-state evidence

elements.name: Execution Input Guard
elements.description: Validates exact work, dependency, assignment, repository, project, policy, and retry lineage before effects.
responsibilities: Reject stale or incomplete baselines
Require exactly one selected work item and one immutable attempt identity

elements.name: Runnable Frontier Validator
elements.description: Derives the current runnable frontier from the static DAG and approved integrated completion facts.
responsibilities: Prove all prerequisites are integrated
Reject adapter-supplied, stale, or forged readiness

elements.name: Execution Binding Validator
elements.description: Validates the version-pinned SpecialistProfile-to-executor mapping and exact declared permission demand.
responsibilities: Bind profile, adapter, configuration, tools, grants, and host policy
Reject mismatched profiles, adapter drift, or expanded authority

elements.name: Execution Result Assembler
elements.description: Builds canonical immutable attempt, ChangeSetDraft, and ExecutionEvidenceBundle artifacts from validated executor bytes.
responsibilities: Reject completion, verification, or integration claims
Bind every output and diagnostic to the exact attempt and workspace base

elements.name: Execution Checkpoint Controller
elements.description: Persists effect results before progression and replays exact attempts without reinvoking executors.
responsibilities: Checkpoint raw executor result and canonical outputs
Create new linked attempt identity for retry after failure or interruption

elements.name: Execution Attempt Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Projects attempted-by and produces relationships from validated execution artifacts only.
responsibilities: Link WorkItem to immutable ExecutionAttempt
Link successful ExecutionAttempt to proposed ChangeSet without creating verification or integration facts

elements.name: WorkItemVerification
elements.description: Verifies one exact immutable WorkExecution result against approved obligations and prepares a Gate candidate without integration authority.
responsibilities: Invoke configured evidence-producing verifiers
Return observations and native artifacts only
Keep verification, progression, and graph authority in Core

elements.name: Verifier Port
elements.description: Provider-neutral boundary for evidence-producing verifier adapters.
responsibilities: Pass one immutable subject, obligation subset, workspace, policy, and binding
Receive raw observations, evidence bytes, diagnostics, and native artifacts

elements.name: Test Verifier Adapter
elements.description: Runs configured test capabilities and returns subject-bound raw evidence.
responsibilities: Execute only approved test obligations
Return command identity, output bytes, result, producer, and subject bindings

elements.name: Review Verifier Adapter
elements.description: Runs configured static, security, documentation, or human-review capabilities through the same evidence contract.
responsibilities: Evaluate only assigned review obligations
Return raw findings without approval or graph operations

elements.name: Verification Input Guard
elements.description: Binds one exact WorkItem, ExecutionAttempt, ChangeSetDraft, evidence bundle, policy, baselines, repository base, and candidate workspace.
responsibilities: Reject absent, duplicate, cross-item, cross-attempt, stale, or mutated subjects
Forbid adapter-authored verification, integration, or completion claims

elements.name: Verification Obligation Expander
elements.description: Deterministically expands every approved verification-plan check and required-evidence obligation.
responsibilities: Combine WorkItem, acceptance, architecture, contract, and policy duties
Require a closed disposition for every obligation

elements.name: Verifier Binding Validator
elements.description: Selects and validates configured verifier adapters from approved evidence kinds and policy.
responsibilities: Bind adapter identity, version, configuration, permissions, and obligation subset
Prove required producer or reviewer independence from the executor

elements.name: Evidence Normalizer
elements.description: Normalizes checkpointed verifier bytes into canonical subject-bound evidence and explicit obligation dispositions.
responsibilities: Validate provenance, raw bytes, producer, command, observed result, and subject digests
Reject missing, stale, substituted, truncated, unrelated, or over-scoped evidence

elements.name: Verification Policy Evaluator
elements.description: Evaluates complete normalized evidence against the exact version-pinned VerificationPolicy.
responsibilities: Return closed verified, failed, needs-evidence, baseline-drift, or unable-to-proceed disposition
Fail closed on unknown policy, uncovered obligation, or independence violation

elements.name: WorkItemVerification Gate
elements.description: Independently validates the exact checkpointed candidate, policy result, evidence closure, and approval bytes.
responsibilities: Issue the only approved per-item verification result
Allow progression only to ChangeIntegration without integration facts

elements.name: Verification Checkpoint Controller
elements.description: Persists raw verifier results before canonical evaluation and replays exact inputs without reinvoking adapters.
responsibilities: Checkpoint every actual invocation
Create a new linked VerificationAttempt for retry or additional evidence

elements.name: Verification Candidate Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Projects candidate verification-attempt relationships from validated canonical artifacts only.
responsibilities: Link WorkItem, ExecutionAttempt, and ChangeSetDraft to VerificationAttempt
Create no verified-by or integration facts

elements.name: Approved Verification Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Projects approved evidence relationships only after exact Gate approval.
responsibilities: Link each acceptance criterion to accepted evidence
Bind update, graph version, execution ID, and resulting checkpoint atomically

elements.name: ChangeIntegration
elements.description: Incorporates one exactly verified work-item change into one configured local Git target without system-verification or business-acceptance authority.
responsibilities: Invoke one configured integration adapter through a provider-neutral port
Return native effect observations and conflict evidence
Never choose scope, alter verified bytes, approve verification, or author graph operations

elements.name: Integration Adapter Port
elements.description: Provider-neutral boundary for one bounded repository integration effect.
responsibilities: Receive one Core-authorized integration plan and declarative grant set
Return exact native Git observations, conflict evidence, diagnostics, and post-state claims

elements.name: Local Git Integration Adapter
elements.description: V1 adapter that applies one verified change and conditionally updates one configured local Git ref.
responsibilities: Use the exact expected target commit and verified change bytes
Perform an atomic conditional ref update or return no-mutation conflict/failure evidence

elements.name: Integration Input Guard
elements.description: Binds one approved WorkItemVerification result, verified change, target snapshot, target ref, expected commit, policy, baselines, and grants.
responsibilities: Reject absent, duplicate, substituted, stale, cross-item, or over-authorized inputs
Forbid adapter-authored approval, scope, system-verification, or business-acceptance claims

elements.name: Integration Plan Builder
elements.description: Builds a deterministic immutable plan for one verified change and one target transition.
responsibilities: Pin pre-state, verified bytes, target ref, expected parent, integration policy, adapter binding, and idempotency identity
Produce the only invocation payload permitted at the adapter port

elements.name: Target Ref Compare-and-Swap Coordinator
elements.description: Owns target-state authority and requires an atomic conditional ref update through the host boundary.
responsibilities: Reject observed target mismatch before adapter mutation
Require the adapter effect to prove expected pre-state and exactly one conditional transition

elements.name: Integration Checkpoint Controller
elements.description: Persists prepared plans and native effect receipts and recovers uncertain effects without duplicate mutation.
responsibilities: Bind checkpoints to invocation, target pre-state, adapter, and idempotency identity
Replay completed effects with zero adapter calls and reconcile crash-after-effect observations

elements.name: Integration Result Validator
elements.description: Normalizes adapter observations into closed canonical integration outcomes.
responsibilities: Prove post-state parentage, tree, ref, verified-change identity, and no-mutation failures
Create IntegratedChangeRecord, updated RepositorySnapshot, IntegrationConflictSet, or closed diagnostic outcome

elements.name: Integrated Change Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Projects factual integration relationships only from a validated IntegratedChangeRecord.
responsibilities: Link WorkItem and ChangeSet to the exact integrated change
Link architecture and contract elements to the resulting change without claiming system verification or business acceptance

elements.name: ArchitectureDiscovery
elements.description: Conditionally discovers implemented architecture for an existing repository lacking an approved baseline or valid current snapshot.
responsibilities: Invoke one mandatory native inventory and configured optional analyzers through provider-neutral ports
Return bounded observations and native evidence without intended-design, Gate, or graph authority

elements.name: Repository Inventory Port
elements.description: Provider-neutral boundary for the mandatory deterministic local repository inventory.
responsibilities: Receive the exact allowed repository surface, revision, policy, options, and grants
Return canonical file, manifest, language, build, package, and boundary observations with exact provenance

elements.name: Native Repository Inventory Adapter
elements.description: Live V1 local adapter that inventories tracked or explicitly declared repository inputs deterministically.
responsibilities: Respect ignore, exclusion, secret, symlink, and submodule policy
Produce a stable minimum discovery observation set independent of optional tools

elements.name: Optional Architecture Analyzer Port
elements.description: Bounded contributor port for tools such as dependency-cruiser, SCIP, or future analyzers.
responsibilities: Receive an explicit version-pinned context slice and declared grants
Return observations only, never completeness, routing, Gate, or graph claims

elements.name: Discovery Route Guard
elements.description: Selects discovery only from exact existing-undiscovered project state.
responsibilities: Reject greenfield, already-discovered, baselined, stale, conflicting, or caller-forced routes
Bind the selected operation to exact project-state evidence

elements.name: Discovery Input and Privacy Guard
elements.description: Binds exact project, repository, policy, adapter-chain, options, and grant inputs.
responsibilities: Reject drift, substitutions, unresolved sources, ignored or undeclared content, and implicit external transmission
Authorize only the exact local inventory and bounded analyzer invocations

elements.name: Discovery Observation Normalizer
elements.description: Normalizes inventory and analyzer observations into provider-neutral current-state findings.
responsibilities: Preserve observed, derived, inferred, unknown, and not-applicable dispositions
Reject duplicate, contradictory, stale, unproven, or authority-expanding findings

elements.name: Discovery Confidence and Gap Gate
elements.description: Evaluates material gaps separately from explicit non-blocking uncertainty.
responsibilities: Return needs_clarification for declared material gaps
Preserve non-material low-confidence findings for explicit downstream Gate disposition

elements.name: Discovery Checkpoint Controller
elements.description: Persists exact inventory and analyzer results before canonical projection.
responsibilities: Bind effect checkpoints to invocation, repository state, adapter, configuration, and step
Replay successful and non-success results without reinvoking tools

elements.name: Current Architecture Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Projects validated observational current-state lineage without approved-design claims.
responsibilities: Link the repository snapshot and source evidence to discovered architecture entities
Create only declared forward observational relationships and atomic merge proof

elements.name: Release Tooling
elements.description: Deterministically materializes and verifies the GitHub source/library release candidate without becoming lifecycle authority.
responsibilities: Project the declared package export contract
Materialize and verify the installable tarball
Assemble exact release evidence and promotion intent

elements.name: Package Export Projector
elements.description: Derives the complete fixed and wildcard public-subpath inventory directly from package.json exports.
responsibilities: Expand wildcard targets deterministically
Reject invalid, duplicate, escaping, or missing export targets

elements.name: Tarball Materializer
elements.description: Builds the exact installable GitHub release tarball from the approved source candidate.
responsibilities: Materialize npm-compatible tarball bytes without registry publication
Bind contents to source, metadata, and export inventory

elements.name: Installed Package Verifier
elements.description: Installs the tarball into a clean consumer and exercises every declared public subpath.
responsibilities: Resolve fixed and expanded wildcard exports
Import executable and JSON surfaces under supported Node versions

elements.name: Release Evidence Assembler
elements.description: Assembles exact catalog, checksums, test results, installed-consumer evidence, governance evidence, and dogfood receipts.

Produce one content-addressed release candidate evidence set

elements.name: GitHub Promotion Adapter

responsibilities: Never publish to npm
Require exact acceptance and repository-setting evidence before promotion

elements.name: Adaptive Interview Orchestrator
elements.description: Orders typed explore, challenge, clarify, and validate strategies while Core owns breadth-first waves, coverage, contradiction detection, and mandatory closure.
responsibilities: Build deterministic question waves
Reject premature requirements closure

elements.name: Provider Toolchain Manager
elements.description: Resolves project-local checksum-pinned provider tools after explicit acquisition approval and never silently upgrades or substitutes them.
responsibilities: Verify provider manifests and checksums
Enforce offline and failure dispositions

elements.name: Execution Receipt Recorder
elements.description: Canonicalizes immutable local raw execution receipts and digest-bound redacted Git views for bounded provider effects.

Redact and validate publishable receipt views

elements.name: Local Performance Metrics Recorder
elements.description: Attaches host-observed cycle, retry, test, cache, change, receipt, token, and tool metrics to ModuleExecutionRecord without inventing unavailable values.
responsibilities: Measure lifecycle performance and overhead
Keep telemetry local and non-authoritative

elements.name: Read-only Trace Query Service
elements.description: Answers provenance, coverage, evidence, impact, and orphan questions from approved graph state using compact deterministic paths.
responsibilities: Provide compact shortest-path results
Prevent every query-side mutation

elements.name: Two-phase Evidence Seal Coordinator
elements.description: Separates the implementation commit from a later evidence-sealing commit so neither commit embeds its own identity.
responsibilities: Bind evidence to an immutable implementation commit
Produce a separate accepted seal reference

elements.name: Live Provider Adapters
elements.description: Hosts bounded live specification, architecture-modeling, and decision-recording adapters without owning workflow progression.
responsibilities: Execute exact bounded provider capabilities
Emit native artifacts and live conformance receipts

elements.name: Specification Provider Adapters

Return explicit provider absence or failure

elements.name: Architecture Provider Adapters

Render decision records without claiming a fictitious MADR CLI

elements.name: ChatGPT Desktop Skills

Delegate all lifecycle effects to released contracts

elements.name: Repository Skill Bridge

elements.name: Optional Godot Engineering Pack

Bind GdUnit4 evidence and compatibility

elements.name: GdUnit4 Verification Adapter

elements.name: Godot Compatibility Registry

Reject inferred compatibility

elements.name: DevRelay Public Facade

Run, resume, verify, and inspect without caller-authored internal artifacts

elements.name: Workflow Profile Resolver

elements.name: API Tier Boundary

Reject forbidden cross-tier imports

elements.name: Prerelease Compatibility Adapter

Retire shims on the approved schedule

elements.name: Release Evidence Asset Publisher

Prove clean-checkout retrieval and offline verification

elements.name: Windows Local Reference Host
elements.description: Provides the durable operator and executor boundary beneath ChatGPT Desktop on Windows.
responsibilities: Persist exact lifecycle state and artifacts
Enforce grants and isolated workspaces
Recover interrupted runs deterministically

elements.name: SQLite State Store
elements.description: Persists runs, transitions, approvals, checkpoints, graph references, leases, and schema migrations transactionally.
responsibilities: Commit state transitions atomically
Expose migration and integrity status

elements.name: Content-addressed Artifact Store
elements.description: Stores exact immutable artifact bytes by digest and verifies media type, size, provenance, and retrieval identity.
responsibilities: Reject digest mismatch and unsafe replacement
Support local and release-asset retrieval

elements.name: Isolated Worktree Manager
elements.description: Creates exact Git worktrees for bounded work items and reconciles their base, candidate, and cleanup state.
responsibilities: Prevent cross-work-item mutation
Bind every workspace to an exact repository revision

elements.name: Capability Grant Enforcer
elements.description: Enforces declared filesystem, process, network, and secret grants at the host effect boundary.
responsibilities: Deny undeclared effects
Receipt every granted external effect

elements.name: Desktop Executor Binding
elements.description: Binds one exact ChatGPT Desktop/Codex executor identity and its declared capabilities to an authorized work item.
responsibilities: Prevent executor substitution
Preserve execution and result receipts

elements.name: Run Recovery Coordinator
elements.description: Reconciles state, artifact, graph, worktree, effect, and Git commit boundaries after interruption without duplicating completed effects.
responsibilities: Resume from the last durable checkpoint
Quarantine ambiguous effects for explicit reconciliation

elements.name: Deterministic Operator CLI
elements.description: Exposes init, run, resume, status, verify, inspect, and evidence commands with stable machine-readable output and exit codes.
responsibilities: Provide the testable Desktop host seam
Keep detailed evidence expandable rather than default

elements.name: RoadmapManagement
elements.description: Cross-cutting semantic module for deterministic roadmap review, candidate triage, and reprioritization without construction-stage or scheduling authority.
responsibilities: Route the three explicit roadmap operations
Invoke configured proposer adapters
Return validated roadmap drafts and diagnostics

elements.name: Roadmap Operation Router
elements.description: Selects triage-candidate, review-roadmap, or reprioritize from the explicit invocation and current roadmap disposition.
responsibilities: Reject implicit operation selection
Route RoadmapNotInitialized to baseline establishment

elements.name: Native Structured Roadmap Proposer
elements.description: Produces provider-neutral roadmap proposals, deterministic priority facts, and exactly one disposition recommendation.
responsibilities: Compare exact context slices
Score with explicit weights
Preserve rationale and duplicate/conflict evidence

elements.name: Optional Planning Adapter Bridge
elements.description: Normalizes proposals from optional external planning systems without granting them roadmap or workflow authority.
responsibilities: Validate adapter maturity and grants
Archive native output and normalize canonical semantics

elements.name: Roadmap Gate
elements.description: Validates exact candidate bytes, coverage, recommendation, replay, owner approval, and baseline drift before atomic promotion.
responsibilities: Own RoadmapBaseline promotion authority
Reject stale, substituted, or incomplete candidates

elements.name: Roadmap Baseline and Projection Service
elements.description: Persists the authoritative structured RoadmapBaseline and deterministically projects concise Roadmap.md bytes.
responsibilities: Preserve disposition history and lineage
Emit UTF-8 NFC LF projections

elements.name: DevRelay Session Bootstrap
elements.description: Loads mandatory current orientation context at the start of each fresh DevRelay task in a configured workspace.
responsibilities: Build an exact SessionContextSnapshot
Emit a SessionContextReceipt before module execution
Permit unrelated ChatGPT chats to remain outside DevRelay

elements.name: Session Context Validator
elements.description: Validates required context, digest bindings, task/workspace identity, current baselines, Gate, frontier, blockers, and refresh state.
responsibilities: Fail closed on missing, stale, malformed, substituted, or mismatched context
Require refresh at the next module boundary after baseline change

elements.name: Roadmap Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Derives approved upstream-to-downstream roadmap and session provenance facts from validated canonical artifacts.
responsibilities: Prevent adapters from mutating the graph
Atomically merge approved roadmap lineage and coverage facts

elements.name: ProjectMemory
elements.description: Cross-cutting semantic module for exact project context retrieval and candidate memory updates.
responsibilities: Load approved project context
Normalize provider retrieval
Propose bounded memory deltas without promotion authority

elements.name: Memory Operation Router
elements.description: Selects load-context, propose-update, refresh-context, or conclude-session from explicit state and invocation.
responsibilities: Reject implicit operation selection
Route recovery for unconcluded sessions

elements.name: Native Memory Baseline Engine
elements.description: Reads exact local baselines and creates canonical candidate deltas.
responsibilities: Apply authority-before-recency ordering
Detect conflicts and supersession
Preserve source locators

elements.name: Memory Provider Port
elements.description: Defines bounded retrieval and indexing capabilities for replaceable providers.
responsibilities: Validate provider maturity and grants
Archive retrieval/index receipts
Normalize provider output

elements.name: Mem0 Adapter
elements.description: Uses Mem0 for derived local session and module-scoped retrieval/indexing without authoritative storage or graph access.
responsibilities: Namespace project, session, module, and invocation identities
Return citations and deterministic receipts
Remain optional and fail-closed

elements.name: Memory Context Assembler
elements.description: Combines authoritative project memory, recent session context, provider retrieval, and trace projection into one bounded handoff.
responsibilities: Enforce authority over recency
Prefer recent session facts only within equal authority
Emit exact context bundle

elements.name: ProjectMemory Gate
elements.description: Validates exact candidate bytes, conflicts, closure, owner disposition, and baseline drift before promotion.
responsibilities: Promote qualitative changes only with exact owner approval
Permit validated status-only updates
Reject inaccurate memory

elements.name: Conclusion Coordinator
elements.description: Implements the idempotent /conclude transition for main and worker tasks.
responsibilities: Collect task state and evidence
Show add/replace/supersede/retain/reject delta
Serialize parent promotion after worker completion
Issue ConcludeReceipt

elements.name: Current Synopsis Projector
elements.description: Renders CurrentSynopsis.md as a concise deterministic full-coverage projection of ProjectMemoryBaseline.
responsibilities: Generate UTF-8 NFC LF bytes
Bind projection digest to baseline
Provide the first semantic handoff for fresh tasks

elements.name: Traceability Context Projector
elements.description: Builds a bounded read-only memory context from the approved TraceabilityGraph checkpoint.
responsibilities: Select relevant lifecycle nodes and edges
Bind graph version and checkpoint
Prevent provider graph access

elements.name: Memory Traceability Contributor
elements.description: Derives approved memory lineage and supersession relationships from promoted canonical artifacts.
responsibilities: Reject adapter-authored graph operations
Merge only approved forward edges
Record atomic merge proof
